one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent hallucinated a non-existent Jaxley API (jx.Mechanism subclasses, add_mechanisms(), group()) and created empty channel shells without implementing the actual biophysical gate dynamics required to replicate the NEURON model.
t_err_evidence: In step 5, the agent writes code subclassing jx.Mechanism (which does not exist in Jaxley), calling self.cell.group(...).add_mechanisms(...) (a hallucinated method), and passing channel parameters through constructor kwargs — none of which are real Jaxley API patterns. The actual Jaxley API requires Channel subclasses with compute_current() and state update methods, inserted via cell.insert() with parameters set via cell.set().
t_commit_evidence: At step 5 the agent writes the file and immediately sets task_complete=true, locking in the hallucinated non-functional implementation with no verification.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked accurate knowledge of the real Jaxley API for defining custom ion channel mechanisms and inserting them into cell compartments. It fabricated plausible-sounding but entirely non-existent class names and method calls (jx.Mechanism, add_mechanisms, group) without consulting documentation or testing, and omitted the required biophysical ODE implementations.
